reason: Named independent lab with the batch report on the page and a QR code is exactly what I check before buying, and the dose is written out. The empty-box guarantee and the $24.99 launch price make one box a low-risk try for my budget.
objection: I only see that a report exists. I would want to open it and see that it matches 200 mg elemental and that the lab is a real one. Also 2 capsules every day is a lot to swallow and there are no reviews yet.
would_change_my_mind: Opening the batch report and finding the lab is unknown, or the numbers do not match the box.
